snippet.title: Angry Birds Star Wars II - Rebels Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Update Angry Birds Star Wars II now and sling 12 brand new characters from the Star Wars Rebels series – each with their own new and super-destructive special power! Put those powers to use helping the Rebellion rid the galaxy of the oppressive Empire in 24 all new levels! Or embrace the Pork Side, and obliterate those incorrigible birds. OR do both!
